topic: Recall: ABC Trading light-up glasses, crown headbands and ties with accessible button batteries

cover.scene: photorealistic candid portrait of a calm 5 year old boy with short dark hair sitting at a kitchen table, soft warm window light, looking slightly aside, neutral relaxed expression, fully clothed in a plain sweater, plain soft dark blurry background, no text, no logos

caption:
Those $1 light-up party toys? One brand has just been recalled.
The US CPSC says ABC Trading's light-up glasses, crown and sparkle headbands and ties have button batteries that children can easily reach. Swallowed button batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.
No injuries have been reported. Check your party bags and dress-up box, and see the slides for model numbers and how to get a refund.

slides.headline: Check the toy box today: a recall covers about 43,674 light-up toys with reachable button batteries. 5 things to know.

slides.title: **What was recalled.**
body: ABC Trading light-up glasses, crown headbands, sparkle headbands and ties. Look for model **L-508** (glasses), **HD-10** (headbands) and **6502** (light-up tie). About 43,674 units.
slides.close: Match the model number, not just the look.

slides.title: **The hazard is the battery.**
body: The button batteries and their compartments can be easily reached by children. Swallowed, they can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death. No injuries have been reported so far.
slides.say: "This one isn't safe, so we're putting it away."
slides.close: Small, shiny and easy to swallow.

slides.title: **Where and when it was sold.**
body: Sold for about **$1** from September 2016 through May 2026, at ABC Trading stores in Los Angeles, other specialty stores nationwide and at abctradinginc.com. Check party favor bags too.
slides.say: "Did you get this at a party?"
slides.close: Cheap party items are easy to forget.

slides.title: **What to do now.**
body: **Stop using them immediately** and contact ABC Trading for a refund. You will be asked to email recallabc@gmail.com a photo showing the product being thrown away. Phone: 323-581-3688.
slides.say: "Thank you for telling me. Let's fix it."
slides.close: Keep it out of reach until it is gone.

slides.title: **Check other toys, too.**
body: Look at any toy with batteries. If the compartment opens easily with small fingers, keep that toy away from young children. Ask your pediatrician if you have questions about button battery safety.
slides.close: A two-minute check can save a lot of worry.

slides.intro: Light-up toys and party favors are everywhere.
